items.text: Rain is expected to spread into the area this afternoon and across much of the area tonight.…
Heavy rain and wind is expected in the area on Thanksgiving.…
Rain is ongoing thanks to a large low pressure system moving across the area.…
After a chilly Thanksgiving week, temps will be on the rise once again.…
Other than a few flurries/sprinkles this evening, primarily precip. free until rain lifts into much of the area.…
Widespread rain moves into the area tonight into Thanksgiving morning, heavy at times in the morning before easing…
